name: DZZ Robotics
summary: DZZ Robotics is a Xi’an developer of educational robots, consumer service robotics and robot motion joints. Its own product portfolio includes the SIGMA family of desktop humanoids and other legged educational platforms. The company provides hardware and teaching resources for schools, universities and robotics training, with emphasis on robot structures, control and hands-on experimentation.
